How low do you rank journalists and reporters on your scumbag meter? Worse than lawyers? Politicians? Lobbyists? Bankers?

I don't often consider labeling a group in such ways. Like with any group (or in our case professions) you are going to have good and bad people in them. If you find journalists and reporters sub par for your standards, you might want to look for a publication that does meet them instead.

Gallup often does surveys on things like honesty/ethics, gauging the public's attitudes toward different professions. I'm interested in hearing how others at Voat rank journalists in a similar fashion.
Not very high. Not quite as low as the ones you mentioned. But that is everything lumped up into one category. I think local journalists do a lot better than the ones nationally

I would put them on a par with politicians, lower than lawyers, bankers and lobbyists. For lawyers, lobbyists and bankers, there is no reason to expect them to represent your interests unless you are in the proper relationship with them. But journalists and politicians pretend to represent everyone's interests, then push one sided interests, lie, fail to allow truth to be told, etc.

The thing is lawyers are supposed to represent their clients. That means any time you don't like their clients, you probably also think the lawyers are bad. That doesn't make them bad, though. There's no subterfuge. They are doing their job and if you dislike them, that may even be evidence they are doing their work well.

Lobbyists are exactly the same. Their entire purpose is to try to push certain policies to favor their clients. No one ever confuses them or their function with public service. Plus, which lobbyists? As with lawyers, chances are there are lobbyists you dislike and ones you don't even really consider lobbyists because they support things that you also support.

Bankers are bankers. They are an very important part of the economy and are necessary for the smooth functioning of business. If you expect them to be focused on anything other than maximizing their own profit in performing their function, that says more about your failings than theirs.

But journalists and politicians? Both of those represent themselves as representing truth, justice, etc. So there is a much greater breach of trust when they lie (either by commission or omission).
